characters.name: Tanjiro Kamado
characters.description: Main protagonist, user of Water Breathing and Hinokami Kagura (Sun Breathing).

characters.name: Nezuko Kamado
characters.description: Tanjiro's sister, a demon who retains her humanity and fights without consuming humans.

characters.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
characters.description: Thunder Breathing user who fights at his best while unconscious.

characters.name: Inosuke Hashibira
characters.description: Beast Breathing user raised by boars, wears a boar mask.

characters.name: Giyu Tomioka
characters.description: Water Hashira, stoic and powerful, first Hashira Tanjiro meets.

characters.name: Shinobu Kocho
characters.description: Insect Hashira, uses poison-based techniques instead of decapitation.

characters.name: Kyojuro Rengoku
characters.description: Flame Hashira, passionate and noble, died fighting Upper Rank 3 Akaza.

characters.name: Tengen Uzui
characters.description: Sound Hashira, former shinobi, flamboyant and powerful.

characters.name: Mitsuri Kanroji
characters.description: Love Hashira, possesses unique muscle density and flexibility.

characters.name: Muichiro Tokito
characters.description: Mist Hashira, prodigy who achieved Hashira rank in two months.

characters.name: Gyomei Himejima
characters.description: Stone Hashira, blind but strongest Hashira, uses a spiked flail and axe.

characters.name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
characters.description: Wind Hashira, abrasive personality but incredibly skilled.

characters.name: Obanai Iguro
characters.description: Serpent Hashira, uses a twisted blade, deeply loyal to Mitsuri.

characters.name: Kanao Tsuyuri
characters.description: Flower Breathing user, Shinobu's adopted sister and Tsuguko.

characters.name: Genya Shinazugawa
characters.description: Sanemi's younger brother, gains demon powers by consuming demon flesh.

characters.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
characters.description: The Demon King, progenitor of all demons, seeks the Blue Spider Lily.

characters.name: Kokushibo
characters.description: Upper Rank 1, former Demon Slayer and Yoriichi's twin brother.

characters.name: Doma
characters.description: Upper Rank 2, leader of the Eternal Paradise Faith cult.

characters.name: Akaza
characters.description: Upper Rank 3, martial artist who seeks strong opponents.

characters.name: Hantengu
characters.description: Upper Rank 4, manifests multiple bodies based on emotions.

characters.name: Gyokko
characters.description: Upper Rank 5, artist demon who creates grotesque 'art' from humans.

characters.name: Daki
characters.description: Upper Rank 6 (shared), uses Obi sash techniques.

characters.name: Gyutaro
characters.description: Upper Rank 6 (shared), Daki's older brother, uses blood sickles.

characters.name: Kaigaku
characters.description: Upper Rank 6 (replacement), Zenitsu's former senior disciple.

characters.name: Yoriichi Tsugikuni
characters.description: Creator of Sun Breathing, strongest Demon Slayer in history.

synergies.name: Kamado Siblings
synergies.description: Tanjiro and Nezuko, bound by family love

synergies.name: Breathing Style Masters
synergies.description: Users of the five fundamental breathing styles

synergies.name: Sun Breathing Legacy
synergies.description: The original breathing style and its inheritors
